artProvenance.prompt: Create one ORIGINAL 3:1 horizontal pixel-art panoramic skybox for abandoned2994 racing game. Exact scene: Rounded inland Monterey oak savanna hills around Laguna Seca, sparse broad-canopy coast live oaks, distant low empty grandstands and tiny paddock tower nestled in a dry bowl; no ocean in immediate background. LIGHTING MANDATORY: DARK NIGHT, subdued navy sky, restrained stars only if clear; never daylight. A small subdued crescent moon is appropriate, never a bright disk. Winter snow on low ground and ledges, exposed steep rock; sparse local dormant vegetation. Quiet sky above distant horizon around60% image height. Local landforms must be distinct and believable, structures far away. No cars, close road, text or logos. Horizontally seamless: both edges match sky colors and terrain height, near features kept central. Engine clamps edge pixels: bottommost row MUST be uniform #263247, lower8% quiet flat matching ground with texture fading into it above, topmost row uniform matching sky. No contrasting border or hard stripe; smooth natural transition to quiet boundary. Clear readable pixel forms at512x192, not generic repeated mountains.
